digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text codec and baseline state machine
propositions: Echo suppression is state-based (current Jira value vs last-synced baseline) because DC codec is lossy and decode(encode(x))≠x cannot gate loops
A change-gated 8-byte inline rich_sha counter detects when the same wire is pushed repeatedly and triggers one GET+merge at threshold to break cycles without per-pass timestamps

Two distinct compares must exist: emit path compares plain inbound-decoded remote vs normalized local; baseline path normalizes only local side through normalize_outbound to match decoded baseline wire
WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound must be redefined as decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) for DC to restore the codec law, but outbound_comments dedup key must remain unchanged to avoid re-posting history

Cloud and DC create paths both must compose to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) identically to their update paths to prevent newly created issues from carrying un-rendered markdown while updates carry rendered wire
The cutover mechanism is flag-gated (defaults OFF) and degrades to plain-text ADF when the marklas optional extra is absent, preserving the reconciler engine's stdlib-only contract
